digests.name: argument digest of a key-ordered object
argument digest is invariant under key permutation (RFC 8785)
same arguments under another tool name give another digest

valid.name: second window overlapping the first by k - 1 calls
single-call final window at the smallest window size and threshold
upper bounds of sequence, window size, threshold and count

invalid.name: call sequence above the tool-call budget bound
first window chained to a previous digest
later window without a previous digest
first window not starting at call one

semantic.name: a chained stream with no repeated couple makes progress
the same couple k times in one window is no progress
polling whose result changes is progress
counts that do not cover the declared span are incomplete
a span wider than the window size is incomplete
a previous digest that is not the prior window preimage breaks the chain
a window bound to another worker invocation is a replay
a tool absent from the plan tools is undeclared
a document altered after signing fails its preimage digest
k identical consecutive calls across a disjoint window boundary are seen in the k - 1 overlap
disjoint windows without the k - 1 overlap are incomplete
a threshold that changes within a stream is incomplete
a non-final window shorter than its window size is incomplete
a threshold above the window size is incomplete
